kharif.soil_advice: Maintain standing water 5-7cm for rice. Apply neem cake for pest prevention.

rabi.soil_advice: Ensure proper drainage. Apply vermicompost 2t/ha before sowing.

zaid.soil_advice: Short-duration crops only. Mulch to conserve moisture.

vedic_qa.What is Brahman?: Brahman is the ultimate reality infinite eternal consciousness beyond all attributes
vedic_qa.What is dharma?: Dharma is righteous action in accordance with the cosmic order and universal truth
vedic_qa.What is karma?: Karma is the universal law of cause and effect governing all actions across lifetimes
vedic_qa.Explain yoga: Yoga is the cessation of mind fluctuations for complete inner liberation and freedom
